title: Prose section
description: A long-form explanation, written in three depth tiers so the reader picks how much they want. `answer` lives in frontmatter because the palette renders it without opening the file. `more` and `full` are H2 sections in the body, split by the compiler on those exact headings.

order.description: Position within the track, for the reader's rail. Gaps are fine and are preferable to renumbering.

answer.description: One sentence, under 45 words, enforced by the linter on word count rather than characters. Written LAST, after `full` exists. A distillation written afterward sounds like a distillation; an opening statement written first sounds like a thesis, and forty authors writing thesis statements produce forty voices. Must stand alone: someone who reads only this gets something correct and useful, not a teaser.

owns.description: Concepts this section is the canonical explanation for. The anti-duplication mechanism: if a concept is not in your `owns`, you link to whoever owns it instead of re-explaining. Everything touches git, so without this every author explains a branch slightly differently.
